phase_status_rule.description: Every gate carries an implicit phase_status condition: features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'. A phase enters as 'idle', flips to 'inprogress' when work starts, and becomes 'completed' once the gate's artifact/check conditions are satisfied. 'completed' is evidence only: it does not authorize crossing a human checkpoint, opening a PR, merging, or bypassing any condition. Phases marked auto_advance=true in phases.json advance automatically once completed and their authorizing checkpoint is satisfied; all others wait for explicit gate authorization. The phase_status_completed condition is repeated in every gate's conditions array for clarity.

set_by: Explicit user agreement on the scope/direction.
automation.brainstorming === true: the orchestrator records the recommended/chosen directions (decisions and summary) and then sets scope_approved = true without asking again.
An explicit user request to skip brainstorming: record brainstorming.user_skipped = true, write the summary from the initial request, and set scope_approved = true.
scope.authorizes: Preparation only for features (prd_creation, prd_splitting, branch creation, track/plan preparation) and branch/plan preparation for bugs/improvements. It never authorizes code changes, PR creation, delivery, merges, live-estate merges, or production promotion.

implementation.set_by: Explicit user approval at the implementation checkpoint, or automation.implementation=true.
implementation.authorizes: Code changes and implementation work only. Never PR creation, delivery, merging, live-estate merges, or production promotion.
implementation.note: Reaching the implementation phase with prepared branch/plans is not approval. Scope approval never implies implementation approval.

delivery.satisfied_when: features[active_feature].delivery is 'local_test', 'open_pr', or 'auto_merge', set by explicit user instruction for this feature/task

options.local_test: User manually tests locally first. Open no PR, merge nothing, and make no live-estate change. Keep the branch/worktree/server available and remain pending at the delivery checkpoint; there is no automatic completion. Only after the user confirms and chooses open_pr or auto_merge does delivery proceed.
options.open_pr: Open the PR(s) and stop. Address feedback only on a separate explicit user request; then use pr_review. Merging remains a human action.
options.auto_merge: Explicit per-task opt-in to open, monitor, fix, and merge under the fail-closed auto_merge_policy. A separate live_merge_approved is still required for data-pipeline.

delivery.fail_closed: delivery null (or absent) means no PR may be opened, no merge may happen, and nothing may be published. Verified explicit persisted consent for the same task may survive resume; never infer it from reconstructed artifacts or copy it from another task. A new task, scope, or target invalidates prior merge consent.
delivery.live_estate: data-pipeline development and main are both live Prefect estates. delivery=auto_merge alone is insufficient: live_merge_approved must be true for this task. Production promotion remains separate human work and is never performed by this workflow.

overrides.complex_bug: recommend subagents; do not switch silently
overrides.user: explicit user override wins and is not re-asked

execution_mode_defaults.consent: execution_mode is not a consent flag. Resolve it after implementation approval and before code changes. Hotfix work uses type 'bug'; no new work type is introduced.

auto_merge_policy.consent: delivery === 'auto_merge', explicitly chosen for this feature/task. open_pr, local_test, and null never authorize a merge.

required_conditions.description: Paginate every PR's review threads to the end (GraphQL first/after until hasNextPage=false). Account for every thread; resolve only threads actually addressed. Zero threads before the configured expected review arrives is not completion.
All required CI checks pass on the latest head SHA.

The actually configured expected review (required reviewers, CODEOWNERS, review decision) is complete on the latest head SHA. Required approvals are current; no changes requested; no unresolved threads.
Self-review, security audit, adversarial review, and the orchestrator's final whole-change review show no must-fix items and no high/critical findings.
No merge conflicts. Branch protections are satisfied and never bypassed or disabled.

Every push invalidates all prior head-specific proof. Immediately before merging, re-read the latest head SHA and confirm it equals the SHA covered by checks, reviews, and verification. Pin the merge call with gh pr merge --match-head-commit <reviewed-sha>; a concurrent push must fail safely.
For data-pipeline, live_merge_approved === true for this task in addition to delivery === 'auto_merge'. Both development and main are live estates.

auto_merge_policy.native_auto_merge: Use a native auto-merge/merge queue only if it enforces every condition above. Otherwise merge only after a final explicit check immediately before the merge call.

watch_budget.override: The user may override either limit for the task.
watch_budget.persist: Record progress, deadline, and fix rounds in the track file. Deadline and round count are preserved on resume, never reset. There is no background daemon; if the session cannot continue, pause the watch as resumable.
watch_budget.on_timeout: Pause, report the current head and open items, and resume only in a later session. Never claim background monitoring or completion.

auto_merge_policy.production: Production promotion is separate human work. No workflow path merges to production or bypasses environment promotion.

skip_semantics.explicit_user_only: Only an explicit user instruction authorizes a skip. Record it; never invent one.
skip_semantics.recording: Record the skip in state/track: brainstorming.user_skipped for brainstorming, or verification['skip:<phase>'] = 'user_skipped: <reason>' for another phase. Set phase_status=completed with the skip note; never claim the skipped artifact exists or that a check passed.
skip_semantics.brainstorming: A user request to skip brainstorming counts as scope approval for the stated request: set brainstorming.user_skipped=true, write the summary from the initial request, and set scope_approved=true. It does not approve implementation or delivery.
skip_semantics.prep_phases: A user request to skip feature PRD creation/splitting skips only those artifacts and proceeds to the implementation checkpoint. Scope approval still authorizes only preparation. Bugs/improvements skip these phases by type, not as user skips.
skip_semantics.conditional_transitions: Resolve one matching next transition per next_strategy key. A skipped conditional branch (e.g. pr_review on a clean merge) is not a failure.
skip_semantics.artifact_override: A recorded explicit user skip satisfies only that skipped phase's artifact conditions for gate evaluation (file exists, required sections, service PRDs). It never satisfies checkpoint authorization, delivery consent, merge conditions, verification evidence, or branch protections.
skip_semantics.human_checkpoints: A skip never crosses a human checkpoint. Automation flags pre-authorize scope/implementation; they are not skips. Delivery is always an explicit choice.
skip_semantics.no_fake_completion: Skipping an artifact does not create evidence. Never mark a check passed that did not run.

idle_to_brainstorming.description: User has filed a new feature/bug/improvement request. Orchestra captures the intent and starts the scope checkpoint.

conditions.description: Feature slug + initial intent recorded on the feature entry.
conditions.check: features[active_feature] exists with at least a slug, type (feature|bug|improvement), and initial_request text

conditions.description: Idle has no real work; orchestra immediately marks idle phase_status as completed when starting a new feature.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

brainstorming_to_prd_creation.description: Feature path only. Once scope_approved is true the preparation phases run automatically: no per-document approval and no /workflow next. Zero-question brainstorms and automation.brainstorming both satisfy the same conditions.

conditions.description: Feature path uses PRD phases.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].type === 'feature'

conditions.description: Scope checkpoint satisfied. Authorizes preparation only.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].scope_approved === true

conditions.description: Every question actually asked has an answer. Obvious-answer decisions are recorded as decisions, not questions.
conditions.check: All entries in features[active_feature].brainstorming.questions[*] have answer !== null

conditions.description: Brainstorming summary captures direction and feeds the PRD.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].brainstorming.summary is a non-empty string
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

brainstorming_to_implementation.description: Bug/improvement path only: skips prd_creation and prd_splitting. Entering implementation reaches the checkpoint; branch creation and plan preparation happen there. No code changes before implementation approval.

conditions.description: Work type must be bug or improvement (feature path uses brainstorming_to_prd_creation).
conditions.check: features[active_feature].type in ['bug', 'improvement']

conditions.description: Scope checkpoint satisfied. Authorizes branch/plan preparation only, never code changes.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].scope_approved === true

conditions.description: Brainstorming summary (or initial-request summary when skipped) captures direction.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].brainstorming.summary is a non-empty string
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

prd_creation_to_prd_splitting.description: Automatic feature preparation after scope approval. No per-document approval and no /workflow next. Main PRD must exist with required frontmatter and sections; this transition never authorizes code.

conditions.check: features[active_feature].scope_approved === true

conditions.description: PRD file must exist.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].prd_path exists as a file

conditions.description: PRD must have required frontmatter fields.
PRD must have required sections.

conditions.check: features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

prd_splitting_to_implementation.description: Automatic feature preparation complete: feature branch created from base AND main PRD split into per-service PRDs/tracks. Entering implementation reaches the implementation checkpoint; remaining plan preparation may finish there. No code before implementation approval.

conditions.check: features[active_feature].scope_approved === true

conditions.description: Agent is on the feature branch created from the latest base: <prefix>vc-<slug>, where <prefix> is feature/ | fix/ | improvement/ per type.
conditions.check: Current branch matches (feature|fix|improvement)/vc-<slug> (legacy form (feature|fix|improvement)/<worker>/vc-<slug> from pre-4.0 features is also accepted) AND equals features[active_feature].branch

conditions.description: Service PRDs/tracks exist for each touched service.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].service_prds has entries for all services listed in main PRD frontmatter
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

implementation_to_pr_submission.description: Implementation authorized, complete, and independently verified. Advances to the delivery checkpoint. Entering pr_submission is not delivery consent and authorizes no PR.

conditions.description: Code work was authorized before it started.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].implementation_approved === true OR features[active_feature].automation.implementation === true

conditions.description: Per-task plan and verification plan/evidence are recorded (verification map or track). Scaled to risk; no requirement to add tests or dependencies.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].verification documents a plan and verification plan/evidence for the implementation round, or track entries record them

conditions.description: All scoped implementation and acceptance work must be complete.
conditions.check: Every scoped task and acceptance criterion in each service track is complete or explicitly deferred by the user; no unresolved must-fix remains. One checked task is not completion.

conditions.description: Must be on feature branch.
conditions.check: Current branch matches (feature|fix|improvement)/vc-<slug> (legacy form (feature|fix|improvement)/<worker>/vc-<slug> from pre-4.0 features is also accepted) AND equals features[active_feature].branch

conditions.description: Orchestrator verification recorded with reproduced evidence: re-run targeted checks/lint/tests, diff review, visual testing for UI, adversarial review, and final whole-change review. Subagent 'done' claims are not accepted on trust; tests are evidence, never 'formal proof'.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].verification is set for the current implementation round and records no must-fix or high/critical findings

conditions.description: TODO reconciles every task and the original request before the delivery checkpoint.
conditions.check: Track/verification records that all tasks and the original request were reconciled, with open items called out explicitly
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

pr_submission_to_pr_review.description: PR is open and has reviewer or bot feedback. delivery must authorize PR opening (open_pr or auto_merge); self code-review and security audit must have already passed.

conditions.description: delivery is open_pr or auto_merge. local_test has not opened a PR yet and stays pending; null fails closed.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].delivery in ['open_pr', 'auto_merge']

conditions.description: The orchestrator's self code-review must be recorded as passed in the PR body.
conditions.check: PR body contains a self-review section with no must-fix items

conditions.description: security-reviewer skill audit must be recorded as passed in the PR body.
conditions.check: PR body contains a security audit section with no high/critical findings

conditions.description: PR URLs must be recorded and exist on GitHub.
conditions.check: features[active_feature].pr_urls has at least one entry and `gh pr view` succeeds for each
delivery === 'auto_merge' OR a separate explicit request to address this task's feedback is recorded in the track. open_pr alone authorizes opening and stopping, not fixes.

conditions.description: PR has at least one open review thread, change request, or failing check.
conditions.check: For every PR, fully paginate GraphQL reviewThreads and REST comments/reviews, inspect effective reviewDecision, and read gh pr checks/statusCheckRollup on the current head. There is an unresolved thread, an outstanding finding/change request, or a failing required check.
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

pr_submission_to_completion.description: PR merged with no outstanding reviewer or bot feedback. Bypasses pr_review. delivery must authorize PR opening; if the orchestrator merged, delivery=auto_merge and auto_merge_policy must have passed.

conditions.check: features[active_feature].delivery in ['open_pr', 'auto_merge']
PR body contains a self-review section with no must-fix items
PR body contains a security audit section with no high/critical findings

conditions.description: All PRs must be MERGED.
conditions.check: `gh pr view --json state` returns 'MERGED' for all entries in pr_urls

conditions.description: No outstanding feedback remains; historical addressed comments do not block completion.
conditions.check: For every PR, fully paginate GraphQL reviewThreads and REST comments/reviews: all threads resolved and addressed, no outstanding finding or effective change request. Historical comments with recorded resolution are not open feedback.

conditions.description: If the orchestrator merged, delivery=auto_merge and every auto_merge_policy condition passed on the latest head. If a human merged, record the human merge; never claim auto-merge proof and never bypass protections.
conditions.check: Human merge recorded, OR (delivery === 'auto_merge' AND auto_merge_policy fully satisfied AND latest head SHA rechecked immediately before merge)
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

pr_review_to_completion.description: All pages of review threads resolved and PR merged. If the orchestrator merged, auto_merge_policy must have passed; a human merge is recorded as such.

conditions.check: features[active_feature].delivery in ['open_pr', 'auto_merge']

conditions.description: Full paginated review-thread inventory is accounted for; every thread is resolved and only addressed threads were resolved.
conditions.check: `gh api graphql` reviewThreads pagination reaches hasNextPage=false and every node has isResolved === true

conditions.description: All PRs must be merged.
conditions.check: `gh pr view --json state` returns 'MERGED' for all entries in pr_urls

conditions.description: If the orchestrator merged, delivery=auto_merge and every auto_merge_policy condition passed on the latest head. If a human merged, record the human merge; never claim auto-merge proof and never bypass protections.
conditions.check: Human merge recorded, OR (delivery === 'auto_merge' AND auto_merge_policy fully satisfied AND latest head SHA rechecked immediately before merge)
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'

conditions.description: Track file must be marked complete.
conditions.check: Track file frontmatter has status: completed
features[active_feature].phase_status === 'completed'
